name: James Henderson
why_targeted: Realtors and land brokers are the primary gatekeepers for landowners who need an architectural feasibility partner before pouring concrete.
source_name: Savills Rural Directory
subject: Architectural & land masterplanning for Savills Rural & Farmland Advisory
body:
Hi James, hope you're having a great week.

I'm Archana, an architect specializing in ecological farm retreats, weekend villas, and land masterplanning.

When your buyers or landowners are evaluating rural acreage and homestead parcels, they often need an architect to see what's actually possible on the terrain: passive cooling, water harvesting, and layouts that sit naturally on the landscape.

If you or a client are ever sizing up a tricky parcel and want a quick second set of eyes on site orientation or building feasibility, I'm always happy to run a quick initial look for you, no strings attached.

A few recent retreat and villa projects: https://www.anvitam.com/projects

If you don't have anything on your desk right now, no worries at all. Feel free to keep us in mind down the road. Are you seeing much interest in acreage or retreat plots this season?

Warmly,
Archana Gavas
Principal Architect, Anvitam Architecture & Ecological Design

subject: Ecological masterplanning & retreat design for Mirvac
body:
Hi Andrew, hope you're having a wonderful week.

I'm Archana, an architect specializing in nature retreats and coastal eco-stays that capture sea breezes while protecting the landscape.

We design passive-cooled earth cottages, decentralized water recycling, and nature-integrated spaces that respect the soil and keep long-term operating costs low.

I'm Archana, an architect specializing in ecological farm retreats, weekend villas, and land masterplanning.

When your buyers or landowners are evaluating hillside lots and sloped estate terrain, they often need an architect to see what's actually possible on the terrain: contour grading, slope drainage, and stepping villa layouts.

If you or a client are ever sizing up a tricky parcel and want a quick second set of eyes on site orientation or building feasibility, I'm always happy to run a quick initial look for you, no strings attached.

A few recent retreat and villa projects: https://www.anvitam.com/projects

If you don't have anything on your desk right now, no worries at all. Feel free to keep us in mind down the road. Are you seeing much interest in acreage or retreat plots this season?

Warmly,
Archana Gavas
Principal Architect, Anvitam Architecture & Ecological Design
https://www.anvitam.com
